name: Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy XCover7 Pro
summary: The Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy XCover7 Pro is a standard Samsung Galaxy XCover7 Pro converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX. It combines increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic). The phone runs Android 16 / One UI 8.x or later.
imageAlt: Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy XCover7 Pro, front view

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIB T85°C Dc
atex.scope: Unit assessment: each unit is checked by a notified body. No certificate number is published.

certification.protection: Increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic)

safety.conditions: Charge in safe area. Each unit spark-tested for intrinsically safe circuits (per Atexxo).

specs.display: 6.6-inch PLS LCD; Vision Booster; Gorilla Glass Victus+
specs.batteryLife: Up to 22 hours of video playback
specs.keys: 2 programmable keys (XCover key and top key, e.g. PTT, emergency)
specs.apps: Samsung Knox with Knox Vault; DeX; Google Play

throughCase.label: Rear cameras
throughCase.value: Front and rear cameras fully functional

throughCase.label: Wireless charging
throughCase.value: No (XCover7 Pro has no wireless charging per Samsung)

capabilities.label: Emergency / SOS
capabilities.value: Built in (programmable key / Samsung Emergency SOS)

unconfirmed.os.version: Current One UI version not confirmed.
unconfirmed.os.securityUntil: Estimated from Samsung's commitment of seven years of security updates from launch.
unconfirmed.specs.dimensionsMm: From Atexxo's order table; its product page repeats the Galaxy S-series dimensions.

strengths: Security updates expected until at least April 2032
A standard Samsung Galaxy XCover7 Pro inside, with Samsung Knox device management
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: not rated for conductive dust
Certified by ATEX unit assessment; no certificate number is published
